title: Project Skill Bootstrap
copilot_cli_intro: Use this workflow when a repository needs a project-local skill layer generated from its detected framework and language stack.
copilot_rules: Inspect the repository for stable stack signals before generating any files.
Generate only the domains the project actually uses.
Keep the root project SKILL.md as a router, not a full framework manual.
Avoid overwriting existing project skill files unless the user explicitly requests replacement.
copilot_avoid: Guessing frameworks without checking repository files
Generating every possible framework reference for a small project
Duplicating large framework documentation into the project skill
vscode_intro: Use this workflow to create a project-local skill bundle based on the repository's detected stack.
vscode_rules: Detect stack signals from repository files before generating anything.
Create a root SKILL.md that routes work to local references.
Generate only the domains that fit the repository.
Avoid overwriting existing files without explicit approval.
instruction_rules: Use the project-skill-bootstrap workflow when a repository needs local skill routing based on its actual stack.
Inspect the repository for stable stack signals first.
Generate a root SKILL.md plus .project-skills/*.md references.
Keep the root file lightweight and routing-oriented.
Avoid overwriting existing project skill files unless explicitly requested.
prompt_intro: Detect the repository stack, then generate a project-local skill router and focused stack references.
prompt_checklist: Inspect stable repository files to infer the stack.
Select only the domains that fit the project.
Avoid overwriting existing files unless replacement is requested.
